notes.title: Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign Demo – Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,

We are excited to announce the release of the Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign demo, giving you a first-hand experience of the tactical command challenges in the Pacific theater of World War II.

What’s in the Demo?
Learn the Basics
Start your journey with a comprehensive tutorial mission to familiarize yourself with the key mechanics of the game. You'll quickly master radio communications, troop coordination, and strategic decision-making.

Mission on Nauru Island
Put your skills to the test in a special mission on Nauru Island. You'll face real wartime scenarios, including coordinating attacks and managing battlefield chaos. Can you rise to the challenge and lead your forces to victory?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3232770/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign_Demo/

Why Play the Demo?
Your Feedback Matters
We value your input! After playing the demo, we encourage you to share your thoughts with us via the in-game feedback form or Steam reviews on the demo page. Your feedback will be instrumental in shaping the development of the full game.

A Taste of What’s to Come
Keep in mind, that the demo represents a game still in development, so certain elements may differ in the full version. Also, please note that saved game progress in the demo will not carry over to the final release.

Join the War Effort Now!
Download the demo today, experience the thrill of radio command, and help us make Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign the best it can be.

We are staying on course, so keep an eye out for further announcements.
Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign team

notes.title: DEMO launches at Steam Next Fest October 2024 + update on the new mechanics
notes.content:
Hello, Commanders!
As it turns out, the Pacific is not the easiest ocean to cross. However, we are slowly pushing forward. Now we’re back with an update for you.

The game is still in production. We are constantly working on expanding the available content to deliver the best possible product to you.

In the meantime, we've added a number of new mechanics and improved the existing ones.

What can you expect?
In some missions, you will have access to tanks - a very powerful unit, though it has its limitations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/fdea5404f692df05685a9595b45391257482af57.png

From time to time, the command will be able to delegate a destroyer to assist you, providing artillery support. However, keep in mind that if misused, it can cause significant damage not only to the enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/86b14d2ed05b6544b815ba530e4ae9d4928c28c3.png

These are just some of the new features that will be waiting for you...

The battles will take place on various Pacific islands. Among the many missions based on historical events, there will also be room for fictional scenarios, allowing you to experience alternate versions of history.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/0ac1ff0893c199470727dc2964beb237a46a761f.png

We have also prepared an additional tutorial mission to help you easily grasp all the basic game mechanics. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/a75fdabdaa7ccb128d88419580c40c31e275d587.png

We also want to inform you that we are showcasing a demo of our game at the Steam Next Fest, which will take place this October. We want to give you a sample of our production to see if we’re heading in the right direction. Your feedback will help us plan our next steps.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621910/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif

We are staying on course, so keep an eye out for further announcements.
Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign team

notes.title: Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign is still under development!
notes.content:
Attention, Commanders!

We're thrilled to provide you with an exciting update on Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign. While the game is still in the process of development, we want to extend our sincerest apologies for the recent lack of communication. These past months have been a challenging period, during which we've been redesigning and enhancing various aspects of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/dbfb9f6588fcc44dd1d1d88f0ab8911b26abd6bf.png

We've taken this time to revamp the game's design and elevate its visual aesthetics. These changes are not only aimed at delivering a more accessible and enjoyable experience for all players, but they also bring the game in line with current standards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/66bbfbbfbeaa0e5e1080c9c19067cafd99a06639.png

Although there's still a lot of work ahead, we're thrilled to report that we're making progress and remain firmly on course to deliver an exceptional gaming experience.

Your patience throughout this journey has been invaluable, and we want to assure you that we're fully committed to the game's development. Rest assured, Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign has not been abandoned

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/897ee5df8a8e2379fea90a4efcd9539efa8e569b.png

In the near future, we'll be sharing further updates about the game. We can't wait to reveal more and continue this journey with you.

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more exciting news!

notes.title: Happy Independence Day!
notes.content:
Ahoy Commanders!

On this very occasion, we would like to share some hot news from the world of Radio Commander! Have you ever wondered how large-scale battles will be conducted? You don't have to anymore! We introduce you to tools such as a mission board, tactical map, and vertical plotting board:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/6aa4ed4ab6d2f7dd1b12c9fd26d90183c6f00a15.gif

Mission Board
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/5e475d4facfaa11f56dbd91317bc6169e23740b7.png
A Mission Board gives you an overview of the current state of air squadrons. You can see the mission that the squadron has to perform, and the time to start and finish it. You can see at what stage the mission is and when it will end.

Tactical Map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/5b38558e3141cb3c0618f6235a1ef88dcc6b8d20.png
A tactical map is a key tool for knowing the current tactical situation. To have proper knowledge of the battlefield, draw elements as reports arrive. You can add here enemy units and their type. Set the front lines, objectives, enemy locations, and tasks for your units, and remember to erase the outdated ones!

Vertical Plotting Board
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/af2b3b977adc6b8bb31257f3ad57d08986d83a26.png
Vertical Plotting Board gives information about the situation in the air near the Task Force. The plotting officer draws the position of his own and enemy planes. Thanks to this, you will direct the fighters to the target when the enemy is heading towards your ships.

We hope you are excited about all that news! Happy Fourth of July and fair winds, Commanders!

Squadron Studio Team

notes.title: News from the Pacific Campaign!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Radio Commanders!

And here is a new screenshot:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/ba078a3dd314d56515c371936ab38860a70143a2.jpg

We decided to share this screenshot with you for two reasons. First: It shows how the player will receive information from the in-game world. With the help of a newspaper! A simple yet elegant solution that was used in those years.

And second: Have you wondered if your actions can change the course of history? Yes, they can! We want you to feel like a real commander in every way. If you look closely at the headline in the newspaper, you will see that it deals with the defeat at Midway. Every decision can have catastrophic consequences!

Additionally, we have posted one more screenshot. A careful eye will find it immediately! Stay attuned to the news from the front!

Fair winds, Radio Commanders!

Squadron Studio Team

notes.title: Radio commander: Pacific Campaign! We are finally here!
notes.content:
Welcome, Radio Commanders!

We are happy to announce that we are here, on Steam, with our first project - Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign. Being fans of the original Radio Commander ourselves we are proud to create our game in the same universe based on similar principles and expand it!

We will show you the Pacific Campaign from two perspectives. One of a Tactical Commander, where you will be close to the troops, just like in the original Radio Commander. But we also want to provide you with a chance of becoming the Strategic Commander who is in charge of moving massive fleets and aircraft squadrons across the whole Pacific Ocean. You will be introduced to the most important battles of the Pacific War and we will give you the freedom to feel alternative outcomes. Change the history!

Add to Wishlist on Steam!

Don't forget to follow and wishlist if You want to be the first to get information about this project! Also - feel free to let us know your initial thoughts about this game coming to life! What do you think about the setting? How do you like the teaser and the screenshots? We are interested in reading it all! 

Best Regards,

Squadron Studio Team
